verdict.rationale: Every Greptile PR review comment has a first-party "Fix with your Agent" button, and the review summary has a "Fix All" button. These send the finding, with file paths, line numbers, and suggested code, to Claude Code, Codex, Conductor, Cursor, or Devin, so an agent-generated follow-up can be started from the PR. The fix itself is produced by a separate third-party agent, and there is no documented Greptile-native way to commit a suggested patch directly in the PR. Missing for 10: a native one-click committed patch or suggestion commit from within the PR, and independent or hands-on evidence that the agent handoff produces applied fixes.

support.subject: As a developer, I turn a review finding into an applied fix — a committed patch or an agent-generated follow-up — without leaving the PR

citations.quote: Every review comment includes a Fix with your Agent button that sends the issue — with file paths, line numbers, and suggested code — straight to Claude Code, Codex, Conductor, Cursor, or Devin.
A Fix All button in the review summary sends every issue at once.
Launch any agent in one click with a Greptile comment, full context, and suggested fix.
